newsitem.title: USA: U.S. aluminum mill product orders firm - Spector.
newsitem.headline: U.S. aluminum mill product orders firm - Spector.

text.p: Aluminum mill product bookings averaged 61.5 million pounds per day in March, compared to 53.4 million in March 1996, and 67.6 million in February, industry analyst Stewart Spector said.
Orders rebounded in the first week of April to 67.9 million pounds per day.
Strength was noted in non-cansheet products, showing a year-to-year increase in March of nearly 29 percent, and the first quarter showed an increase of 25.6 percent over the same quarter last year.
Can sheet bookings continued to lag. In March they were 17.1 percent less than they were in March 1996, and year-to-date were off 3 percent.
"The weakness reflects light weighting, and a drop in beer can usage," Spector said.
